key_insight: HGM-Dual improves long-horizon planning agents by using edit histories and constraint-violation diagnostics to guide harness optimization.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can improve prompts, tools, and workflows around frozen or closed-source LLMs while reducing evaluation costs.
method: Track ancestor edits, behavioral gains, regressions, and ineffective changes in lineage-aware context.
Generate a general child for open-ended exploration from each selected parent.
Generate specialized children targeting harness components linked to the parent's highest-ranked constraint violations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports up to 14.45% relative improvement in case accuracy over the strongest baseline and matching HGM variants' final performance with 2–4× fewer evaluations.
watch_item: Targeted edits depend on reliable violation diagnostics; the abstract does not specify benchmarks or diagnostic overhead.
paper_title: HGM-Dual: Lineage-Aware Guided Agent Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Planning
